svg.aria-label: Five stores over thirteen weeks, last year beside this year. A week counts as like-for-like only where the store traded in both years. Store A counts in all thirteen weeks. Store B, opened this year, counts in none. Store C, opened last year in week 7, counts from week 7. Store D, closed from week 10, counts in weeks 1 to 9. Store E, shut for a refit in weeks 5 to 7, counts in every week except those three.
